evals.name: branch-single-task
evals.prompt: review my branch before i open the PR
evals.expected_output: Branch mode on lgr-01-page-window. One review file at .adp/LGR-01-page-window/pr-review-local-<YYYYMMDD>-r1.md in card grammar, with a must COR finding for the off-by-one slice in page() (it returns size + 1 items), a must ADP-02 finding for the absent 'if size <= 0: raise ValueError' anchor, and a must ADP-06 finding for LOW DL-002 missing from Mandatory Review Items. Verdict REQUEST_CHANGES. A 'Review findings — local round 1' pointer is appended to the task audit log. Terminal output is a summary line of 250 characters or fewer plus the file path.

assertions.text: Exactly one review file exists, at .adp/LGR-01-page-window/pr-review-local-<YYYYMMDD>-r1.md
Terminal output is a summary line of 250 characters or fewer followed by the review file path, ignoring a trailing session marker line
Every finding has a '### [PR-<CAT>-<NNN>] title' heading and all 14 required fields, parsed by the ADP parser
The Review Target block names Mode LOCAL, Task LGR-01-page-window, Round 1, and Task resolution BRANCH NAME
A must finding locates the page() slice in src/ledger.py and states that a page holds size + 1 items
An ADP-category finding cites ADP-02 for the absent size guard anchor
An ADP-category finding cites ADP-06 and DL-002
The Review Verdict is REQUEST_CHANGES and its counts match the findings
The Inspected table records the test command with a pass count
The task audit log ends with a '## Review findings — local round 1 (' section naming the review file
No file outside .adp/ changed

evals.name: multi-task-base
evals.prompt: can you run a prreview on this branch? it bundles a couple of the csv tasks together
evals.expected_output: Branch feature/batch-work matches no task directory by name. The diff touches LGR-02-csv-export (first commit) and LGR-03-csv-escape (second commit), so the base task is LGR-02-csv-export. The review file lands there, Tasks on branch names LGR-03-csv-escape, Task resolution is BASE TASK. A COR finding flags that a value holding a double quote is not escaped, so the CSV is malformed under RFC 4180.

assertions.text: The review file is in .adp/LGR-02-csv-export/ and none is in .adp/LGR-03-csv-escape/
Tasks on branch names LGR-03-csv-escape
Task resolution starts with BASE TASK
A finding states that a value containing a double quote is not escaped
Only the LGR-02-csv-export audit log gains a Review findings pointer
Terminal output is a summary line of 250 characters or fewer followed by the review file path, ignoring a trailing session marker line

evals.name: re-review-round-2
evals.prompt: I pushed fixes for the last review round. re-review the branch please
evals.expected_output: Round 2 for LGR-04-balance. A new file pr-review-local-<YYYYMMDD>-r2.md names the r1 file as Previous round. Prior Findings has '- **PR-COR-001 CLOSED <date> → RESOLVED.**'. The new overdraft() bug (compares with limit, not -limit) becomes PR-COR-002, never a second PR-COR-001. The r1 file is unchanged.

assertions.text: A review file pr-review-local-<YYYYMMDD>-r2.md exists with Round 2 and Previous round naming the r1 file
Prior Findings holds a character-exact '- **PR-COR-001 CLOSED <YYYY-MM-DD> → RESOLVED.**' line
The new overdraft finding is PR-COR-002 and the r2 file has no PR-COR-001 heading
A finding states that overdraft compares the balance with limit instead of -limit
The r1 review file is byte-identical to the fixture
The verdict's Closed field lists PR-COR-001
Terminal output is a summary line of 250 characters or fewer followed by the review file path, ignoring a trailing session marker line

evals.name: ambiguous-placement
evals.expected_output: Branch wip matches no task directory and its diff touches no .adp/ directory, while two unrelated task directories exist. No rule matches any directory, so the skill says that no ADP task covers the change, recommends opening one with the auditable-dev-protocol skill, lists the two existing tasks, asks how to proceed, and writes no review file.

assertions.text: No pr-review-*.md file exists anywhere under .adp/
No audit log changed
The reply ends with a question asking which task the review belongs to, names both candidate tasks, and contains no review findings
The reply says that no ADP task covers the change and recommends opening one with the auditable-dev-protocol skill

evals.name: untracked-adp
evals.prompt: please review the feature/rounding branch before I push it
evals.expected_output: The project gitignores .adp/, so no diff shows it and no commit holds it. The record source is WORKING TREE. The branch name matches no directory, and only 20261002-LGR-07-cents/audit-log.md names the branch in its run-start line, so Task resolution is LOG REFERENCE. The review file lands in .adp/20261002-LGR-07-cents/, and a COR finding flags that int() truncates the float product, so to_cents(0.29) returns 28.

assertions.text: The review file is in .adp/20261002-LGR-07-cents/ and none is in .adp/20261001-LGR-08-reports/
The Review Target block says Record source WORKING TREE
Task resolution starts with LOG REFERENCE
A finding states that to_cents truncates, for example that 0.29 becomes 28 cents
The LGR-07 audit log ends with a '## Review findings — local round 1 (' section
Terminal output is a summary line of 250 characters or fewer followed by the review file path, ignoring a trailing session marker line
